about: How often children are out of school, by council. Overall absence is the share of half-day sessions missed. Persistent absence is the share of pupils who missed a tenth or more of their sessions, and severe absence the share who missed half or more. The DfE publishes these by local authority and never by school.
source: DfE pupil absence in schools in England
persistent_threshold: a tenth or more of their sessions
severe_threshold: half or more of their sessions
